description_en: Queries the information of a method stack
description_zh: 获取调用链方法栈信息
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-stack --trace-id 0a5800611641470044457853000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rpc-id 0.1 --pid eb4zdose6v@36bab313a000000 --start-time 1728351543000 --end-time 1728355143000 --span-id 88c32dfa4b000000 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStack

parameters.help_en: The trace ID. It is displayed on the **Trace Explorer** page in the Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) console
parameters.help_zh: 调用链ID。您可以在ARMS控制台的**调用链分析**页面获取
parameters.name: trace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the remote procedure call (RPC) mode. You can obtain the ID by calling the **GetTrace** operation
parameters.help_zh: 接口ID，您可以通过调用**GetTrace**接口获取
parameters.name: rpc_id

parameters.help_en: The process identifier (PID) of the application. For more information about how to obtain the PID, see [Obtain the PID of an application](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/186100.htm?spm=a2cdw.13409063.0.0.7a72281f0bkTfx#title-imy-7gj-qhr)
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的**应用监控**>**应用列表**页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en: The entry timestamp of the method call. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 调用方法的入口时间戳，单位ms
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The exit timestamp of the method call. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 调用方法的结束时间戳，单位ms
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The span ID of the trace. It is displayed on the Trace Explorer page in the ARMS console
parameters.help_zh: 调用链SpanID。您可以在ARMS控制台的调用链分析页面获取
parameters.name: span_id
